About me

Hi, I'm Jayvee.

I'm a freelance web and SEO specialist working with local service businesses across the US and Australia, mostly trades contractors who are great at their craft but whose websites haven't kept up with the business.

My work sits at the intersection of design and data. I rebuild sites so they load fast and look sharp, tune them so they rank for the searches that actually bring in jobs, and set up automation so no lead falls through the cracks.
